name: Susan Moore
office: La Cañada Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Susan Moore is a retired English teacher. She says that during her nearly two decades at La Cañada High School, she taught all grade levels, including Honors and AP Literature, and served as department chair, on the school site council, and as the founding Diamond Award coach for the school's debate program. She previously worked in entertainment and ran a business.

She says she wants to maintain academic excellence, support teachers, and ensure fiscal stewardship. At a candidate forum, she called for a consistent district policy on artificial intelligence and urged parent collaboration on responsible AI use. She named hiring and retaining teachers and supporting student well-being as priorities.
